title: Limit Bi-Shadowing for Semi-Hyperbolic Systems
summary: This paper investigates the shadowing properties in semi-hyperbolic systems. We introduce three classes of shadowing properties defined on families of manifolds, and prove that a semi-hyperbolic family possesses the $L^p$ bi-shadowing property, the limit bi-shadowing property, and the asymptotic bi-shadowing property under certain conditions. The proof strategy is to transform the shadowing problem into a fixed-point problem, and then apply the Brouwer fixed-point theorem to complete the verification.
